abstract: Publication of this standard in May 1953 revises the original one issued in 1947. The text of the Foreword, Specification and Appendix A is reprinted below. The complete text of the Standard also includes: Appendix B, “Report on the Tests Which Formed the Basis of the First Edition (1947) of This British Standard”; Appendix C, “Report on Tests Made to Provide Data for the 1953 Edition of B. S. 1404”; and Appendix D, “Notes on the Method of Measurement Specified in Appendix A.”
